edits.value_json: {"scene":"quiet_bow","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"The last note settled over the pond, and Frog held his breath beside the listening reeds.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"soft","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]}

{"scene":"duet_bow","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"The final twirl slowed, leaving Mia, Teo, and Frog poised above a pond full of tiny ripples.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"duet","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]}

{"scene":"boat_bow","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"The floating concert drifted onward, with the leaf boat bumping gently behind the lily.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"boat","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]}

{"text":"A single silver bubble rose beside the lily. Nora’s eyelids lifted, Frog’s toes curled with pride, and the pond held the little song as carefully as a pocket holds a button.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"soft","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}

{"text":"The reeds shivered once, then rested. Frog’s enormous smile became quiet enough to fit beside Nora’s shining bubble in the moonlit water.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"soft","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}

{"text":"Mia’s feet pattered, Teo’s bell twinkled, and Nora tapped the water until the ripples looked like dancing commas. Frog bowed, accidentally wobbled, and made the commas wiggle harder.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"duet","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}

{"text":"The final lullaby-note floated away while Nora tapped a bright little rhythm. Ripples danced across the pond, and Mia’s grin was nearly as wide as Frog’s.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"duet","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}

{"text":"Nora glided past on the lily while Frog sang from its middle. The leaf boat bumped along behind like a very small royal carriage, carrying no crown—only a splendid wobble.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"boat","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}

{"text":"The lily made a slow circle, with Nora smiling aboard and Frog singing in the middle. Behind them, the leaf boat bobbed after its queenly captain, one tiny bump at a time.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"boat","at":"after"},{"key":"frog.performed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}
